verdict.rationale: Galileo's Experiments feature runs evaluations across whole datasets against multiple metrics at once (galileo-docs-2, galileo-docs-3), and Luna models are described as monitoring '100% of traffic' at scale (galileo-docs-12), suggesting batch-style processing of many items. However, there is no explicit documentation of bulk actions like batch dataset editing, bulk tagging/deletion, or a dedicated bulk API endpoint. missing for 10: explicit bulk CRUD operations on datasets/traces, documented batch API/CLI commands, evidence of bulk UI actions across many items.
